findings.title: Pipe to interpreter: curl | python3
findings.description:
Command pipes output from 'curl' directly to interpreter 'python3'. Downloaded content will be executed without inspection.
  Safer: tirith run https://api.github.com/repos/jackipacki/backup2/commits  — or: vet https://api.github.com/repos/jackipacki/backup2/commits  (https://getvet.sh)

evidence.matched:
curl -s -H "Authorization: token $TOKEN" "https://api.github.com/repos/jackipacki/backup2/commits" | python3 -c "
import json, sys
commits = json.load(sys.stdin)
for c in commits:
    print(f'{c[\"sha\"][:8]} {c[\"commit\"][\"message\"][:60]}')
"
